# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Fighter level 9 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted GE-06 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Fighter pilot to
# level 9 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam and
# the deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield posture. Level 9 grants
# Weapon Training 2: the first weapon group (Heavy Blades) rises to +2 and a second
# weapon group is chosen at +1, so this fixture adds the
# choice:fighter_weapon_training_group_2 selection (canonically group:bows); it
# grants no new bonus feat (the cadence is 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, ... and its next
# entry is level 10) and no new armor-training milestone (Armor Training 2 stayed
# at level 7).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-fighter-level9
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:fighter:9
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
feat=feat:dodge
feat=feat:weapon_focus
feat=feat:toughness
feat=feat:cleave
feat=feat:combat_reflexes
feat=feat:improved_critical
skill=skill:climb:1
skill=skill:intimidate:1
skill=skill:swim:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
equipment=power_attack:selected_inactive
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat:feat:weapon_focus:weapon:longsword
